plugins.name: adage
plugins.description: Agent traces become reflexes: Adage compiles the paths your agents take into reflexes and tells them, deterministically, what to do next. Needs the adage binary on PATH (npm, Homebrew, or the release installers).

plugins.name: adage-exec
plugins.description: Adage with execution (opt-in): after `adage delegate on` and a person's `adage review delegate` per reflex, observe-only lookups run in an OS sandbox at the stimulus and their typed output arrives beside the directive (E1), and approved actions such as `make gen` after an edit run staged, verified and applied from the hook (E2). Replaces the Adage plugin's hooks while execution is on. Needs the adage and adage-exec binaries.
